fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects when an attacker tries to add a new network provider in order to dump clear text credentials, similar to how the NPPSpy tool does it
fields.name: Potential Credential Dumping Attempt Using New NetworkProvider - CLI
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and (tgt.process.cmdline contains "\\System\\CurrentControlSet\\Services\\" and tgt.process.cmdline contains "\\NetworkProvider"))
